specifications.name: Harmonic distortion
specifications.text: Less than 0.25% from 3Ohz to 20Khz Less than 0.5% from 2Ohz to 20Khz (Measured at watt output level) The M124 is a high performance audio amplifier designed to offer optimum flexibility with minimum space occupancy for custom console applications in the broadcast and sound recording industries: The unit exhibits low input noise (-124 dbm) high output capabi" lity (1 watt), uniform frequency response and exceptionally low total harmonic distortion In addition, the M124 printed circuit module measures Only 37 X 5h X 1 3/8 (component width) and includes a specially designed input transformer for multiple source impedance operation

specifications.name: Input level
specifications.text: dbm maximum A unique active, balanced output circuit permits totally balanced systems design without the use of bulky output transformers and the attendent distortion introduced by such components at high output levels The low impedance presented at the amplifier output terminals permits the use of multiple resistive splitting networks with maximum isolation between output lines

specifications.name: Output level
specifications.text: +3Odbm, watt maximum Conditional strapping is accomplished on the card connector Thus, M124 modules maybe readily interchanged within system without regard to function An entire console system (monitor amplifiers excepted) maybe designed around the M124 plug-in card

specifications.name: Phasing
specifications.text: The low terminal number of the input pair and the low terminal number of the output pair are in phase

specifications.name: Power requirements
specifications.text: volts dc regulated_ 100 mA at watt output level
